series.title: Envoy AI Gateway v1.1.x
series.subtitle: Token counting, per-request credentials, stream idle timeout, MCP hostname routing, OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing, and HTTP CONNECT egress.

releases.overview: Envoy AI Gateway v1.1.0 is the first minor release on the stable 1.x API. It adds token counting across providers, per-request upstream credentials, stream idle timeout with failover, MCP hostname routing and CEL backend selection, optional OpenTelemetry GenAI tracing, and HTTP CONNECT egress. Upgrading from v1.0 needs no CRD migrations; the only operator-facing change is Helm's restricted controller security context.

items.title: vLLM-compatible /tokenize across providers
items.description: Count tokens for a prompt without generating a completion. Chat messages and completion prompts use the vLLM tokenize request shape against vLLM, Vertex AI Gemini, GCP Anthropic, AWS Bedrock Converse, and AWS Anthropic. Native Anthropic clients can use /anthropic/v1/messages/count_tokens; Responses API clients can use /v1/responses/input_tokens (OpenAI and Azure OpenAI).

items.title: Anthropic-format /anthropic/v1/models
items.description: Claude clients that call Anthropic's model list endpoint now get the gateway's configured catalog in Anthropic's response shape, scoped by hostname the same way /v1/models is.

items.title: Per-request upstream credentials via credentialOverride
items.description: A trusted filter can supply the backend credential per request instead of sharing one static key in BackendSecurityPolicy. Source from Envoy dynamic metadata (preferred) or a request header the gateway strips before the backend. API keys, Anthropic, Azure, GCP, and AWS SigV4 are supported.

items.title: HTTP CONNECT forward proxy
items.description: GatewayConfig.spec.forwardProxy tunnels upstream LLM connections through an HTTP CONNECT proxy (host:port). Bedrock requests through PrivateLink now sign over the actual upstream host, so VPC endpoints no longer fail with a silent 403.

items.title: Stream idle timeout with failover
items.description: AIGatewayRouteRule.streamIdleTimeout bounds how long Envoy waits without upstream bytes on a streaming response. If it fires before the first token, a retry policy can fail over to the next backend; mid-stream it returns 504. Pair with a BackendTrafficPolicy whose retry covers reset.

items.title: Hostname routing and backend selection
items.description: MCPRoute.spec.hostnames scopes an MCP endpoint to specific hosts. backendSelector restricts which backends a session fans out to via CEL rules evaluated at initialize (default Deny). Initialize now advertises merged backend capabilities, and the controller shares one Envoy Gateway Backend per namespace.

items.title: OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions and Grafana dashboard
items.description: Set AI_GATEWAY_TRACING_SEMCONV=gen_ai on the ext-proc to emit gen_ai.* span attributes. An example dashboard for gen_ai_* Prometheus metrics ships in examples/monitoring/grafana-dashboard.json. Controller and ext-proc logs accept --logFormat=json; MCP resource reads populate mcp_resource_uri in access-log metadata.

items.title: Structured output for Claude on Vertex AI
items.description: JSON-schema constrained decoding now works for Claude models on Vertex AI that advertise output_config. OpenAI reasoning_effort is forwarded to Bedrock as reasoning_config.

items.title: Responses API tool_search, unknown tools, and Codex inputs
items.description: The Responses API accepts the built-in tool_search tool and additional_tools, preserves unknown tool types, and accepts Codex-style agent input items.

items.title: Controller hardening and sharded config secrets
items.description: The chart can emit a PDB, honour topologySpreadConstraints, and attach extra podLabels. Filter configuration is split across multiple Secrets so large Gateway configs no longer hit Kubernetes' 1 MiB Secret size limit.

apiChanges.title: AIGatewayRouteRule.name
apiChanges.description: Optional unique name copied onto the generated HTTPRoute rule. route-not-found is reserved.

apiChanges.title: AIGatewayRouteRule.streamIdleTimeout
apiChanges.description: Optional Gateway API duration; unset means no per-try idle timeout.

apiChanges.title: BackendSecurityPolicy.spec.credentialOverride
apiChanges.description: Optional per-request credential source. Exactly one of fromRequestHeaders or fromDynamicMetadata. fallbackToConfigured defaults to true.

apiChanges.title: GatewayConfig.spec.forwardProxy
apiChanges.description: Optional HTTP CONNECT proxy. address is required (host:port).

apiChanges.title: MCPRoute.spec.backendSelector
apiChanges.description: Optional CEL selector evaluated at session initialize. defaultAction defaults to Deny.

bugFixes.title: Stale Content-Encoding on translated error responses
bugFixes.description: Translated error bodies no longer keep the upstream Content-Encoding header. Clients no longer fail to decode an uncompressed error payload that still claimed to be gzip or brotli.

bugFixes.title: Anthropic ping events keep streams alive
bugFixes.description: Anthropic ping SSE events now emit an empty chunk on translated paths, so intermediaries and clients that time out on silence no longer drop a healthy Claude stream.

bugFixes.title: Gateway local replies are not reprocessed as upstream responses
bugFixes.description: Ext-proc no longer treats Envoy local replies (rate-limit, timeout, auth) as provider payloads. Local error bodies pass through instead of being force-translated into a malformed LLM response.

bugFixes.title: Anthropic cache_control on the Bedrock path
bugFixes.description: Prompt-caching cache_control markers now translate onto AWS Bedrock, including tool-result cache control and Bedrock tool cache points as their own tools[] element. Cached prefixes that previously silently dropped now actually hit Bedrock's cache.

bugFixes.title: Bedrock reasoning_content serialized as a plain string
bugFixes.description: Non-streaming and streaming Bedrock reasoning content is emitted as a plain string, with signatures carried via thinking_blocks. Clients that expected a string and previously received an object no longer fail to parse Claude-on-Bedrock reasoning.

bugFixes.title: Unsupported Anthropic tool types error instead of dropping
bugFixes.description: Unknown Anthropic tool types now fail the request rather than being silently stripped. You get a clear error instead of a tool-less prompt that looks like it succeeded.

bugFixes.title: Cross-namespace InferencePool backendRef honours namespace
bugFixes.description: An InferencePool referenced from another namespace is now resolved in that namespace instead of the route's. Cross-namespace inference pools that previously 404'd at reconcile now work when the ReferenceGrant allows them.

bugFixes.title: Anthropic streaming cache tokens no longer double-counted
bugFixes.description: Input and cache token counts on Anthropic message_delta events are merged once, including on the OpenAI→Anthropic streaming path. Usage metrics and access logs no longer inflate cached-token cost on streaming Claude calls.

bugFixes.title: Credential leak in Envoy ext-proc debug logs
bugFixes.description: Envoy HTTP and ext-proc debug logging is capped, and credential header mutations are always redacted in debug output. Passthrough endpoints also redact user content. Debug-level logging is no longer a credential-exfiltration path.

bugFixes.title: Gemini streaming tool-call finish reasons and reasoning tokens
bugFixes.description: Newer Gemini models such as gemini-3.5-flash now map streaming tool-call finish reasons correctly, and reasoning tokens are counted in streaming metrics. Streaming Gemini tool use no longer reports a wrong finish reason or drops thinking-token usage.

breakingChanges.title: Helm controller security context defaults
breakingChanges.description: The Helm chart now sets a restricted podSecurityContext and container securityContext on the controller (non-root UID/GID 65532, all capabilities dropped, no privilege escalation, RuntimeDefault seccomp). Previously both were empty. If you run a custom controller image that cannot use UID 65532, override controller.podSecurityContext and controller.securityContext in your values.
